caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate teapot. The teapot is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting graphite or pencil as the medium, on a cream-colored background. It features a rounded, bulbous body with vertical fluted ridges running from top to bottom, a domed lid with concentric ring details and a circular knob on top, and a wide, sturdy base. The spout is elongated and curves upward, ending in a slightly flared tip with a small decorative finial. The handle is large, curving upward and then downward, with shading suggesting it is either darker in color, made of a different material, or simply more shadowed. There are two small red marks to the left of the teapot and a signature reading "Frank Nelson" in the bottom right corner. The overall composition centers the teapot prominently and does not include any other objects.
title: Pewter Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
